Class EfRepository<T>

Namespace
HiveSync.Data.Repositories
Assembly
HiveSync.Data.dll

Generic repository for user-owned, trackable entities with soft-delete support. Automatically filters entities by DeletedAt and OwnerId.

public class EfRepository<T> : IRepository<T>, IReadOnlyRepository<T> where T : class, ITrackable, IBaseEntity, IOwner

Entity type implementing ITrackable, IBaseEntity and IOwner.
